description: User says 'what is this?' while camera is pointed at a single object (a mug). Deictic detector fires (deictic_reference=True); grounding pass resolves the current frame to label='mug' with high confidence. SpeakPolicy produces full_response. Negative sub-case: same scene but user says 'what time is it?' (deictic_p < 0.3) — no grounding pass runs, no deictic_grounding event is emitted.

fixture_conventions.deictic_p: Scripted DeicticModel output probability. >= 0.8 => deictic gate fires. < 0.3 => non-deictic, no grounding pass.
fixture_conventions.scene_change_score: Scripted scene-change score. Low values indicate static scene.
fixture_conventions.grounding_result: Stub label returned by GroundingModel when deictic gate fires.
fixture_conventions.grounding_confidence: Stub confidence. >= 0.7 => confident answer; < 0.5 => low confidence / hallucination-resistance path.
fixture_conventions.sub_case: 'deictic' or 'non_deictic'. Consumers (task 9) assert: deictic sub-case emits deictic_grounding event tracing to the correct raw_video_frame; non-deictic sub-case emits NO deictic_grounding event.
fixture_conventions.frame_bytes_synthesis: raw_video frame blobs are minimal synthetic placeholders: b'\x89VID\x00' + 1 index byte. Grounding results are scripted.
fixture_conventions.target_frame_event_id: The deictic_grounding event must have caused_by[] referencing the raw_video_frame event_id of frame-002 (the frame the grounding ran against). Task 9 asserts this causal chain.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels for human readability.
